title: Establishing glioma stem cell spheroids and cancer-associated fibroblasts from patient tumor
author: Delmas, Cohen-Jonathan-Moyal, et al.

steps.title: Prepare CAF culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix 450 mL DMEM F‑12 with 50 mL fetal bovine serum (10 % v/v) to obtain CAF culture medium; store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare GSC culture medium
steps.instruction: Prepare 40 mL DMEM F‑12 supplemented with N2/B27, basic FGF and EGF as described in the Materials section; store at 4 °C for up to 1 week.

steps.title: Collect tumor specimen
steps.instruction: Obtain surgically resected GBM tissue and place it in 10–15 mL phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS); process within 2–4 h. If delayed, keep the sample in DMEM‑F12 at 4 °C for up to 24 h.

steps.title: Mince tissue into small fragments
steps.instruction: Place the tumor piece with PBS in a 60 × 15 mm cell‑culture dish. Cut the tissue into pieces small enough to pass through a P1000 tip using sterile scissors (or a scalpel). Transfer any difficult‑to‑cut fragments to a 1.5 mL microtube and mince further with scissors.

steps.title: Transfer fragments to tube
steps.instruction: Move all minced fragments together with the PBS into a conical 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Shake tissue suspension
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a laboratory shaker set to 200 rpm and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min; no enzymatic digestion is required.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 260 × g for 5 min at 20–25 °C. Carefully discard the supernatant, then resuspend the pellet in 6 mL GSC growth medium containing penicillin‑streptomycin at 1 % (v/v).

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the resuspended cells through a sterile 100 µm cell strainer into a fresh conical 50 mL tube. This filtrate will be used for both 3D GSC spheroid culture and 2D CAF expansion.

steps.title: Initiate 3D GSC spheroid culture
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL of the cell filtrate to a T25 flask (reserve the remaining 1 mL for CAFs). Incubate the flask at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 95 % humidity for 24 h.

steps.title: First spheroid medium change
steps.instruction: After 24 h, transfer the suspended cells to a 15 mL conical tube, centrifuge at 260 × g for 5 min at 20–25 °C, discard the supernatant, and add 5 mL fresh GSC growth medium containing penicillin‑streptomycin at 1 %. Transfer the suspension to a new T25 flask and return to the 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 95 % humidity incubator.

steps.title: Routine spheroid medium replacement
steps.instruction: Replace the GSC spheroid medium twice weekly by repeating the centrifugation (260 × g, 5 min, 20–25 °C), removal of supernatant, and addition of 5 mL fresh growth medium with 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin.

steps.title: Cryopreserve mature GSC spheroids
steps.instruction: When spheroids reach 300–400 µm (2–4 weeks), transfer 4.5 mL of the spheroid suspension to a 15 mL conical tube, add 0.5 mL dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), and mix gently. Aliquot 1 mL into each of five cryotubes, place them at –80 °C for 24 h, then transfer to liquid nitrogen for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Initiate 2D CAF culture
steps.instruction: Prepare a T25 flask with 4 mL CAF culture medium (DMEM F‑12 + 10 % FBS) containing penicillin‑streptomycin at 1 %. Add the reserved 1 mL cell filtrate, and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, 95 % humidity for 24 h.

steps.title: Routine CAF medium changes
steps.instruction: After 24 h, discard the old medium and add 5 mL fresh CAF culture medium (with 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin). Change the medium twice weekly until the cells reach confluence (2–4 weeks).
